summary: Grayscale Chainlink Trust ETF filed an 8-K on 2026-10-05 reporting that the Sponsor, Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, on behalf of the Trust, entered a Sixth Amendment to the Master Custody Service Agreement with Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. on 2026-09-29, making the Trust a party. The amendment adds Anchorage Digital as an additional custodian for a portion of the Trust's LINK holdings; Coinbase remains primary custodian and the Sponsor retains sole discretion over allocation, with no amount determined. A routine custody arrangement, not a special situation.
